title.narrative: The Digital Transitioning Programme for Jamaica (Digital Jamaica)

description.narrative: Contract related to: The Digital Transitioning Programme for Jamaica (Digital Jamaica) - The Action will support Jamaica¿s on-going activities towards achieving a digital economy and society by 2030 through 3 pillars: (1)Island-wide broadband and connectivity infrastructure coverage, (2)digital transformation support for MSMEs (including upskilling) within the context of overall business transformation and (3)integrating digital skills trainings (including TVET) into the public education system).
